hero.heading: Professional Grading, Driveways, Erosion Control & Land Clearing Across Northwest Florida
hero.subheading: From driveways and grading to erosion control and land clearing — we get the job done right with professional-grade John Deere equipment.
hero.hero_image_alt: Professional skid steer services on the Emerald Coast in Northwest Florida

services.name: Driveway Installation & Grading
services.description: New driveway installation, regrading, and repair. Gravel, dirt, and shell driveways built to last.

services.name: Land Grading & Leveling
services.description: Precise grading for proper drainage, building prep, and landscape leveling across your property.

services.name: Erosion Control & Silt Fencing
services.description: Silt fence installation, erosion control measures, and stormwater management for residential and commercial sites.

services.name: Irrigation Prep
services.description: Trenching and site preparation for irrigation system installation. Get your property ready for water.

services.name: Root Raking & Land Clearing
services.description: Clear overgrown lots, remove roots and debris, and prep your land for building or landscaping.

services.name: Fence Line Prep & Installation
services.description: Fence line clearing, post hole prep, and fence installation for residential and agricultural properties.

services.name: Custom Skid Steer Work
services.description: Got a unique project? We handle any skid steer job — from material spreading to demolition prep and everything in between.

why_us.title: Skid Steer Specialist
why_us.body: Not a general contractor — focused expertise on skid steer work means efficient, high-quality results every time.

why_us.title: John Deere Reliability
why_us.body: Professional-grade John Deere equipment with grapple bucket, regular bucket, and rental attachments for any job.

why_us.title: Emerald Coast Expertise
why_us.body: We know the local terrain, soil conditions, and weather challenges across Northwest Florida.

why_us.title: Flexible & Equipped
why_us.body: Grapple, bucket, and rental attachments available — no job too big or too small.

why_us.title: Honest & Straightforward
why_us.body: No-nonsense communication, fair pricing, and we show up when we say we will.

about_snippet.heading: Owned & Operated by Jonathon Smyley
about_snippet.body: Jonathon Smyley, owner and operator. Milton, FL based. Recently invested in a John Deere skid steer to focus on what he does best — moving dirt and getting jobs done right. Serving the Emerald Coast and all of Northwest Florida.
